goal: Async streams review: cancellation, disposal and the cost of buffering large results.
use: Async streams review: cancellation, disposal and the cost of buffering large results. Use when code uses IAsyncEnumerable or async streams.

steps.note: List the streams. Each producer and consumer.
Check cancellation. Each stream must honour its cancellation token.
Check disposal. Flag enumerators that are never disposed.
Check buffering. Flag streams that collect everything into a list first.
Report. Each stream with file and line, the problem and the fix.
